new_findings.summary: SubdeviceStatusInformation points DeviceStatusInformation to table 27, but table 19 is DeviceStatusInformationStructure and table 27 is InstallUpdateRequestStructure.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: none; do not derive structure routing from the wrong table number

new_findings.summary: The table of contents numbers GetUpdateHistory, FinalizeUpdate and FinalizeAllPendingUpdates as 1.33/1.34/1.35 while the body correctly uses 2.33/2.34/2.35.
Update-history prose and the XSD documentation annotation say InstallationSuccessfull, while the PDF enumeration table and executable XSD enumeration value are InstallationSuccessful.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: accept only InstallationSuccessful according to the selected XSD; do not create typo alias

new_findings.summary: Section 2.9 is GetDeviceErrorMessages but the request prose calls it GetDeviceErrorMessage singular; operation table and XSD use the plural name.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: do not synthesize a singular operation alias
